title: Long-term partnership
learning_outcomes: Explain visible and invisible labour in the context of long-term partnership.
Compare and distinguish connection routines in the context of long-term partnership.
Apply renegotiation in the context of long-term partnership.
Evaluate and justify decisions about shared review in the context of long-term partnership.

lessons.title: Visible and invisible labour
lessons.outcome: Explain visible and invisible labour in the context of long-term partnership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving visible and invisible labour; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to household partnership plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain visible and invisible labour from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of visible and invisible labour; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Connection routines
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish connection routines in the context of long-term partnership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving connection routines; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to household partnership plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain connection routines from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of connection routines; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Renegotiation
lessons.outcome: Apply renegotiation in the context of long-term partnership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving renegotiation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to household partnership plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain renegotiation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of renegotiation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Shared review
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about shared review in the context of long-term partnership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving shared review; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to household partnership plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain shared review from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of shared review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of visible and invisible labour; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of connection routines; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of renegotiation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of shared review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
